user.title: Set up Print Timelapse Archive
user.description: Record a timelapse of every print. Frames are captured from a camera entity whenever the status sensor reports a printing state, and a video is assembled and archived when the print ends.

data.job_name_attribute: Status attribute holding the file name
data.reserve_gb: Free space to keep in reserve

data_description.camera_entity: Any existing camera entity with a view of the print bed. A test snapshot is taken before saving.
data_description.status_entity: For example a PrusaLink, OctoPrint or Moonraker status sensor.
data_description.printing_states: Comma-separated states that mean a print is running, such as: printing, busy
data_description.job_name_attribute: Optional attribute of the status sensor with the model or G-code file name, shown in the archive.
data_description.fps: Frames per second of the assembled timelapse videos.
data_description.reserve_gb: Archiving stops before the disk drops below this much free space.
data_description.keep_frames: Off by default: only the videos and a preview frame are kept.

error.cannot_capture: Could not get a snapshot from this camera. Check that it works in Home Assistant.
